items.name: Standard
items.summary: The standard printer, which implements grep-like formatting, including color support.

methods.name: get_mut
methods.signature: fn get_mut(&mut self) -> &mut W
methods.summary: Return a mutable reference to the underlying writer.

methods.name: has_written
methods.signature: fn has_written(&self) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this printer has written at least one byte to the underlying writer during any of the previous searches.

methods.name: into_inner
methods.signature: fn into_inner(self) -> W
methods.summary: Consume this printer and return back ownership of the underlying writer.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(wtr: W) -> Standard<W>
methods.summary: Return a standard printer with a default configuration that writes matches to the given writer.

methods.name: new_no_color
methods.signature: fn new_no_color(wtr: W) -> Standard<NoColor<W>>
methods.summary: Return a standard printer with a default configuration that writes matches to the given writer.

methods.name: sink
methods.signature: fn sink<'s, M: Matcher>(&'s mut self, matcher: M) -> StandardSink<'static, 's, M, W>
methods.summary: Return an implementation of `Sink` for the standard printer.

methods.name: sink_with_path
methods.signature: fn sink_with_path<'p, 's, M, P>(&'s mut self, matcher: M, path: &'p P) -> StandardSink<'p, 's, M, W> where M: Matcher, P: ?Sized + AsRef<Path>
methods.summary: Return an implementation of `Sink` associated with a file path.

items.name: StandardBuilder
items.summary: A builder for the "standard" grep-like printer.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<W: WriteColor>(&self, wtr: W) -> Standard<W>
methods.summary: Build a printer using any implementation of `termcolor::WriteColor`.

methods.name: build_no_color
methods.signature: fn build_no_color<W: io::Write>(&self, wtr: W) -> Standard<NoColor<W>>
methods.summary: Build a printer from any implementation of `io::Write` and never emit any colors, regardless of the user color specification settings.

methods.name: byte_offset
methods.signature: fn byte_offset(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Print the absolute byte offset of the beginning of each line printed.

methods.name: color_specs
methods.signature: fn color_specs(&mut self, specs: ColorSpecs) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the user color specifications to use for coloring in this printer.

methods.name: column
methods.signature: fn column(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Print the column number of the first match in a line.

methods.name: heading
methods.signature: fn heading(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Enable the use of "headings" in the printer.

methods.name: hyperlink
methods.signature: fn hyperlink(&mut self, config: HyperlinkConfig) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the configuration to use for hyperlinks output by this printer.

methods.name: max_columns
methods.signature: fn max_columns(&mut self, limit: Option<u64>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the maximum number of columns allowed for each line printed. A single column is heuristically defined as a single byte.

methods.name: max_columns_preview
methods.signature: fn max_columns_preview(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, if a line is found to be over the configured maximum column limit (measured in terms of bytes), then a preview of the long line will be printed instead.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new() -> StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Return a new builder for configuring the standard printer.

methods.name: only_matching
methods.signature: fn only_matching(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Only print the specific matches instead of the entire line containing each match. Each match is printed on its own line. When multi line search is enabled, then matches spanning multiple lines are printed such that only the matching portio…

methods.name: path
methods.signature: fn path(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, if a path was given to the printer, then it is shown in the output (either as a heading or as a prefix to each matching line). When disabled, then no paths are ever included in the output even when a path is provided to the p…

methods.name: path_terminator
methods.signature: fn path_terminator(&mut self, terminator: Option<u8>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the path terminator used.

methods.name: per_match
methods.signature: fn per_match(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Print at least one line for every match.

methods.name: per_match_one_line
methods.signature: fn per_match_one_line(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Print at most one line per match when `per_match` is enabled.

methods.name: replacement
methods.signature: fn replacement(&mut self, replacement: Option<Vec<u8>>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the bytes that will be used to replace each occurrence of a match found.

methods.name: separator_context
methods.signature: fn separator_context(&mut self, sep: Option<Vec<u8>>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the separator used between discontiguous runs of search context, but only when the searcher is configured to report contextual lines.

methods.name: separator_field_context
methods.signature: fn separator_field_context(&mut self, sep: Vec<u8>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the separator used between fields emitted for context lines.

methods.name: separator_field_match
methods.signature: fn separator_field_match(&mut self, sep: Vec<u8>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the separator used between fields emitted for matching lines.

methods.name: separator_path
methods.signature: fn separator_path(&mut self, sep: Option<u8>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the path separator used when printing file paths.

methods.name: separator_search
methods.signature: fn separator_search(&mut self, sep: Option<Vec<u8>>) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Set the separator used between sets of search results.

methods.name: stats
methods.signature: fn stats(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: Enable the gathering of various aggregate statistics.

methods.name: trim_ascii
methods.signature: fn trim_ascii(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut StandardBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, all lines will have prefix ASCII whitespace trimmed before being written.

items.name: StandardSink
items.summary: An implementation of `Sink` associated with a matcher and an optional file path for the standard printer.

methods.name: begin
methods.signature: fn begin(&mut self, _searcher: &Searcher) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: binary_byte_offset
methods.signature: fn binary_byte_offset(&self) -> Option<u64>
methods.summary: If binary data was found in the previous search, this returns the offset at which the binary data was first detected.

methods.name: binary_data
methods.signature: fn binary_data(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher, binary_byte_offset: u64) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: context
methods.signature: fn context(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher, ctx: &SinkContext<'_>) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: context_break
methods.signature: fn context_break(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: finish
methods.signature: fn finish(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher, finish: &SinkFinish) -> Result<(), io::Error>

methods.name: has_match
methods.signature: fn has_match(&self) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this printer received a match in the previous search.

methods.name: match_count
methods.signature: fn match_count(&self) -> u64
methods.summary: Return the total number of matches reported to this sink.

methods.name: matched
methods.signature: fn matched(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher, mat: &SinkMatch<'_>) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: stats
methods.signature: fn stats(&self) -> Option<&Stats>
methods.summary: Return a reference to the stats produced by the printer for all searches executed on this sink.
